sources.title: GitHub - google-research/byt5
sources.snippet: ByT5 is a tokenizer-free extension of the mT5 model. Instead of using a subword vocabulary like most other pretrained language models (BERT, XLM-R, T5, GPT-3), our ByT5 model operates directly on UTF-8 bytes, removing the need for any text preprocessing. sources.title: GitHub - lingjzhu/CharsiuG2P: Multilingual G2P in 100 languages
sources.snippet: CharsiuG2P is transformer based tool for grapheme-to-phoneme conversion in 100 languages. Given an orthographic word, CharsiuG2P predicts its pronunciation through a neural G2P model. This repository also contains instructions to replicate our Interspeech 2022 paper ByT5 model for massively multilingual grapheme-to-phoneme conversion [arXiv] [pdf].

sources.snippet: In this study, we tackle massively multilingual grapheme-to-phoneme conversion through implementing G2P models based on ByT5. We have curated a G2P dataset from various sources that covers around 100 languages and trained large-scale multilingual G2P models based on ByT5.
